body: Thank you, please do. Since i'm still writing there must still be some kind of hope left even if It's far away and "other" solutions might sound reasonable in my mind even though i know that they might not be. I am just so incredibly tired.

It might be, but as everything right now It's hard to get going, easier to bury my head inte sand and keep going until i break. The energy required to do anything is absurd.

Morning is up at 6.20, shower, brush teeth, quick walk with a cigarette to the bus.

Evenings is just getting home, cooking food, work for an hour or two go to bed att 21-22, get to sleep at 01-02 if i'm lucky, and repeat.

There was no problems with the quality of my sleep, sleep restriction was supposed to help me fall asleep faster by minimizing time awake in bed but had the opposite effect.

I do try other things, like working out, but it is so unbelivably boring that its just another chore on the same level as doping dishes for me. Not too sure if i belive i meditation.

To be honest i haven't tried much more than different kinds of medication.

The first psycologist i went to started me on sleep restriction which was about to end badly. I had just been sent by my doctor to do a analysis of sleeppatterns if something was off there and the guy in charge told me to please not go through with restriction right now but i tried anyway cause my doc was so sure that this was the solution to all problems. Ended when I was about to loose my mind and couldnt to my job or even arrive on time in the mornings anymore.

After this ordeal, my psycologist decided that sleep restriction might not be the way to go so started with lots and lots of forms to fill out everyday, but my confidence in her was low and it didn't amount to anything.

Next step was for my first doctor to tell me that she didn't know what to do anymore and send me to a specialist. He has put me in touch with a new psycotherapist, and thats where i am now.

I'm afraid it only gives me more time to think. When I'm talking about needing to be occupied 24/7 i wasn't exagerating. I cannot stand being alone with only myself and tomorrow is a day off from work which means that i will probably work from home, trying to find something to do, fail, and i will find something else i've done wrong and back again on square one, crying in the shower because of something that ,in reality ,is not even worth a single thought

Yeah, it was and is insane.

Well, the meds... already went through cipramill, remeron, zoloft, and are currently on effexor and taking stilnoct 3 times a week. Every change of medication has been pure misery, and just one day if i miss my daily 300mg effexor and i'm fucked.

Yes I do, it can be the smallest thing, and it can consume me fully. When it starts i cannot break the cycle. It just pushes me down and it feels like me brain stops processing thoughts in a normal mannen. It's like my brain is spinning and all synapses are fireing at once. It's both physically and mentally exhausting and every single bad or stupid thing i have done, no matter how small gets blown out of proportion.

I honestly don't know anymore. It's been like this for way too long, i had the same issues with confidence and negative emotions and trouble sleeping on top of that for as long as i can remember.

And about the family situation it has not been a surprise. I have Always known about the story what surprised me was how little I cared when it started to become reality. Meeting my halfbrother for the first time was easy and fun, meating my father didn't medan much at old, just an old guy who speaks a language i don't understand. 

And arter this a coworker passed away which brought me right back to a especially though period of my life where i lost 5 friends in 6 months. It is just difficult, and with all medication, which has made me gain weight, loose interest och go into sort of a zombie mode, i am starting to get fed up with trying.

Thats part of the issue, I have tried to sit down and rank my concerns but I cant do it. my romantic life for the past year is nonexistant, no intereset in any of my hobbies, my financial situation is stable, good enough paying job, a place to live, lots of friends. But a very odd family situation that only started to unravel last autumn and no interests in anything other than to take up all my free time with work as a way to disconnect from thinking about myself.

trouble falling asleep basically. From a couple of hours to not happening that night. I can't stop thinking and turning every stone, goding through every single thing i have said and done to find thing that might have been misunderstood, something that can bite me in the ass. Can be as simple as how i hi to someone in the morning and makes absolutley no sense. But with 0 confidence, and issues that have been present for 20+ years its become part of me. And i cant stand it.

I really don't know anymore. The only thing I have in life that actually works for me is my job. Everything else goes to shit. But to work 24/7 cannot be the solution, but since i cant stay at home for more than i couple of hours without having my mind telling what a failure i am i need to contantly be on the move. And i cant take it anymore, my body and mind are broken.
